visual.title: An arrow at every point
visual.caption: The arrows are not a trajectory. Each one is the vector the field assigns to that point, and the streamlines are the curves that follow them. The loop is the path the integrals use.

predict.question: What does one arrow in this figure represent?
options: The value of a scalar function at that point
The vector assigned to that point
The path a particle has already travelled
predict.explain: A vector field assigns a vector to each point. The arrow is that vector, so it shows direction and relative size, not a history of motion.
